title: Queue file override encode advisory
summary: Removes the Queue file override route-impact confirmation checkbox and replaces it with a bottom-of-drawer encode advisory that reports whether backend preview/effective settings may force encode.
reason: Operators need route-impact feedback without an extra confirmation override control; the drawer should show whether the selected override may encode or forces encode while keeping backend preview/save authoritative.
behavior_before: When backend route preview returned a medium/high impact, the drawer rendered an "I understand this may force a full transcode" checkbox and refused to save route/video overrides until it was checked.
behavior_after: The drawer no longer renders or requires the route-impact checkbox. Backend route preview still runs before saving, preview errors still block save, and a footer advisory says "Force encode", "May encode", or "May encode: no" based on backend preview/effective evidence.
manual_validation: Bundled Python unittest: static route-control assertion - passed
change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed due unrelated MP-CHANGE-2026-0605-010.json missing date_completed and not covered by an unreleased packet
